mentions.name: Inkfeed
mentions.description: A free and open-source web-based RSS reader for the Kindle that works in the Kindle browser, so articles can be read directly without sending them via Amazon or Calibre.
mentions.problem: Reading RSS articles on a Kindle normally requires sending articles via Amazon or Calibre.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on a FOSS Web-based RSS reader for the Kindle that works on the Kindle browser, no need to send articles via Amazon or Calibre!

It's called Inkfeed
